profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer | Veteran | JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, React, C#, .NET, SQL, Git, Node.js
profile.summary:
I am currently a Full Stack Software Engineer with experience working in various open-source frameworks such as JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Git, NodeJs, SQL, C#, .NET, and React.js. The technical field is by far the most rewarding industry I have worked in because it is always evolving, which provides opportunities to continue to learn and grow as a technically skilled professional.

I have a military background where I served in the Marine Corps for 4 years in an Administrative position. Afterwards I attained my Bachelor of Arts degree from California State University Dominguez Hills in Computer Information Technology. I gained IT experience in college through work study program serving as helpdesk for the campus Library computer systems. Then I worked for Xerox Inc. in a technical capacity installing and servicing printers and fax machines on a large scale Network for the Los Angeles County Department of Social Services.

Currently I am collaborating on a team to develop and deploy multiple websites utilizing various open-source packages. I am skilled in troubleshooting issues and resolving bugs within an existing system. I am able to research and execute solutions based on online guides and tutorials with a technical aptitude. I pride myself on a strong work ethic, positive attitude, and motivation to learn. I have the ability to work independently as well as in team environments.
